newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Dominion Bridge to cut stake in McConnell.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dominion Bridge to cut stake in McConnell.

text.p: Dominion Bridge Corp of Canada said on Friday it planned to cut its stake in Australian construction group McConnell Dowell Corp to about 65 percent from 79 percent through the issue of about six million shares.
Dominion, formerly Cedar Group Inc, said the shares would be issued at A$2.25 each for a total of about A$13.5 million.
McConnell shares were trading at A$2.05 on Friday, up 10 cents from Thursday's close.
Dominion said the issue was intended to provide additional market liquidity and interest in McConnell Dowell shares.
"Dominion Bridge does not intend to make further placements from its holding," the company said.
Dominion said the shares would be placed with institutions by County NatWest and SBC Warburg.
